STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE **1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS** - All styling lives in `style.css`. **Forbidden:** any `style="..."` attribute in HTML. - All design properties, layout rules, and states are applied via class/ID selectors only. - HTML stays semantic and clean; changing the look requires editing only CSS. **1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens** Define in `:root` (and duplicate under `.dark` / `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)`): - **Colors:** `--primary` (Sketch Blue #4A90D9), `--secondary` (Highlighter Yellow #FFF176), `--bg-primary` (Notebook White #FAFAF5), `--bg-secondary` (paper card surface, e.g. #FEFEFE — never pure #ffffff), `--text-primary` (Ink Black #1A1A1A), `--text-secondary` (Pencil Grey #4A4A4A), `--text-success` (Doodle Green #66BB6A), `--text-error` (Marker Red #EF5350), `--border-default` (#4A4A4A), `--border-success`, `--border-error`. - **Accent tokens:** `--accent-yellow: #FFF176`, `--accent-red: #EF5350`, `--accent-green: #66BB6A`, `--accent-orange: #FFA726`. - **Contrast pairing:** every light background pairs with dark text; every dark background pairs with light text — enforced in both themes. In dark mode, invert: dark paper background (#1E1E1A or similar) with light text (#FAFAF5), keeping marker accents brightened for contrast. - **Shape & depth:** `--radius-sm: 4px`, `--radius-md: 10px`, `--radius-lg: 18px`, `--shadow-sm`, `--shadow-md` (keep shadows soft/sketchy — e.g. offset solid shadows like `4px 4px 0 var(--border-default)` to mimic hand-drawn drop lines). - **Spacing & motion:** `--spacing-gap`, `--transition-fast: 0.15s`, `--transition-normal: 0.3s`, `--ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)`. - **Stacking:** `--z-dropdown`, `--z-modal`, `--z-toast`. **1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode** - Define dark tokens under both `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` and a `.dark` class on ``/``. - Theme toggle button in the header: visible control with `aria-pressed` and `aria-label="Toggle dark mode"`, using a Google Material Symbol icon (e.g. `dark_mode` / `light_mode`). - Persist choice in `localStorage`; fall back to `prefers-color-scheme` on first visit. - Notebook paper lines/grid must also adapt (lighter line color in dark mode). **1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First** - All layout containers use Flexbox; **default `align-items: center`** unless justified otherwise. - Mobile-first: card grids, pricing tiers, steps, and footer link columns stack to a single column on small viewports; no horizontal scrolling ever. - `box-sizing: border-box` globally. **1.5 Framework** - Use **Tailwind CSS via CDN** (or plain custom CSS organized with `@layer`/`@apply` if preferred) — but all theme values must map back to the CSS variables above.
